messages.subject: How to estimate "Bias-corrected bootstrap CI"?
parts:
Dear all.

Can I estimate "Bias-corrected bootstrap CI" with sem() function?

And then, Satorra-Bentler Test with bootstrapping is a method of "Bias-corrected bootstrap CI"?

Like this:

result <- sem(model, data = data, estimator='ML', se="bootstrap", test="satorra.bentler", bootstrap = 100000, verbose=TRUE)

--
Seongho Bae

messages.subject: Re: How to estimate "Bias-corrected bootstrap CI"?
parts:
Check the help page of the parameterEstimates function. For example,

parameterEstimates(fit, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple")
